fields.rationale: AXI does not define a JTAG/scan/BIST/MBIST/debug architecture. There is no dedicated debug interface. Debug visibility, if any, must be added by the integrator outside this spec.

spec_provided_observability.name: AxUSER / RUSER / WUSER / BUSER
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Implementation-defined user signals to convey extra info per transaction or per beat. AXI does not define their function; spec recommends against using them due to interoperability risk.

spec_provided_observability.name: Default-slave DECERR injection
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Interconnect should route undecoded accesses to a default slave that returns DECERR; useful for catching out-of-map accesses.

spec_provided_observability.name: Trace signals (E1.4)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Optional AMBA 5 trace signaling for observability (not detailed in extracted pages).

AXI5_E1_features_mentioned_in_TOC: E1.17 Write zero with no data

evidence.quote: USER_REQ_WIDTH: 0 to 128 (AWUSER, ARUSER). USER_DATA_WIDTH: 0 to DATA_WIDTH/2 (WUSER, RUSER). USER_RESP_WIDTH: 0 to 16 (BUSER, RUSER).
Generally, this specification recommends not to use User signals. The AXI protocol does not define the functions of these signals, which can lead to interoperability issues.

If the interconnect cannot successfully decode a slave access, it must return the DECERR response. This specification recommends that the interconnect routes the access to a default slave, and the default slave returns the DECERR response.
